about: TacoSort (was TidyInbox): open-source tool that sorts every email account into one folder scheme and keeps it sorted

runs.title: TidyInbox built by a nodeterm team, reviewed, fixed, published
runs.summary: Four builders and an integrator built TidyInbox in the shared tree; a three-lens review, a five-station fix wave and a re-check cleared every blocker before it went public with green CI.

stages.name: Plan
stages.note: SPEC.md, shared models, FakeBackend, station briefs

sessions.did: Spec, contracts, briefs, merges, re-check fixes, rename, publish, CI fixes
Providers, keychain + OAuth, ImapBackend with safe moves
Guards, user rules, heuristics, optional AI; 149 tests
SQLite store, learner, engine, scheduler; 68 tests
CLI, config, README, docs, CI, issue templates
Wired stations together; fixed a schedule command line that always failed; e2e tests
2 blockers: Gmail labels learned as move-out, UIDVALIDITY Inbox sweep
Fake server too perfect to catch real-server bugs
10 findings: safe move after drops, folder case, keychain names
AI injection guard, verify-email, rule fixes
Install from GitHub, reserved ids, umask, keychain cleanup
All blockers fixed; found N-1 (learned rule vs security codes), N-2 (MOVE + search lag)

lessons: spawn-team/verify are refused while the project is off screen: open stations one by one with open-claude --run-now
A perfect fake server hides real-server bugs: give it Gmail-label, no-UIDPLUS and partial-move modes
Check PyPI before naming a project: mailtidy was taken, forcing a late rename
Short random ids collide on fast CI machines: 4 hex chars overwrote a run record
Fix stations' full-suite failures came from neighbours mid-edit in the shared tree; the orchestrator's run after the wave is the real check

runs.title: Rename to TacoSort, first real mailbox, company folders
runs.summary: One session renamed the tool TacoSort, ran it on the owner's Gmail, fixed what real Gmail showed (tabs, a security alert) and added company folders and an Accounts folder.

sessions.did: Rename, real Gmail preview, Gmail tab search, security phrases, company folders, Accounts folder, backlog sort (31 moved)

lessons: Real Gmail hides its tabs from X-GM-LABELS: only an X-GM-RAW category search finds them
A live scheduled task on an editable install runs whatever code is on disk: keep it working between edits

runs.title: Second account, learning from repetition, Security and Business folders
runs.summary: The same session added the owner's business Gmail, then taught TacoSort to file unsure and look-alike company mail, wait 24 hours, re-check the Inbox daily and move old security and business mail to their own folders.

sessions.did: Mac CI re-run, SRGaming setup, unsure-to-company + hold_hours, look-alikes + daily re-check, Security and Business folders; 250 emails moved

events.text: Scheduled run did the first daily re-check with new code (46 moved)

lessons: Robot-header checks miss shops that mail from plain sales@ addresses: repetition is the better robot signal
nodeterm write eats backslashes like bash: send Windows paths with forward slashes
